metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-a1[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Expose bead history and make bead completion truthful[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A closed bead is trustworthy evidence and a bead's working history [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]is readable: every note revision the event streams already hold is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reachable from the CLI, notes accumulate instead of being [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]overwritten, the ~509 beads whose notes lost earlier revisions can [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]be repaired, closing a parent no longer silently manufactures [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]completion for descendants nobody worked, every closure records a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]done/canceled/superseded resolution, and reopening a bead reopens [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the ancestors whose completion claim it invalidates.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]bead_history_truthful_close.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Read the event streams as a per-bead timeline[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]history[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]history: add a Rust replay API that turns a bead's event stream into an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ordered list of field-level changes, expose it through the PyO3 binding,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and ship `sase bead history` as its first reader.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Record and display how a bead was resolved[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]resolution[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]resolution: add a stored done/canceled/superseded resolution to the bead[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record end to end — wire, close event, SQLite mirror, Python model, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the close CLI — and surface it with the close reason, which no [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]human-readable surface prints today.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Append to bead notes instead of replacing them[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]note[dim] · [dim][/dim]after history[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]note: add an atomic append-a-note mutation in the Rust core and a `sase [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bead note` verb, so recording progress no longer destroys what an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]earlier writer left behind.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop closing descendants nobody worked[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]invariant[dim] · [dim][/dim]after resolution[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]invariant: make the parent-close cascade explicit rather than silent — [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reject a close whose descendants were never closed on their own, require[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]force plus a reason and a non-done resolution to override, record which [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]descendants were swept, and reopen closed ancestors whenever a bead [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]leaves the closed state.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Find and repair notes lost to overwrite[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]recover[dim] · [dim][/dim]after history, note[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]recover: detect beads whose current notes dropped text an earlier [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]revision held, report them, and offer a confirmation-gated repair that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]re-appends the dropped revisions with provenance.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Land the new surfaces as one coherent contract[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]integrate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after invariant, recover[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]integrate: reconcile the two halves into one documented contract — bead [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs, the generated `sase_beads` skill, the land and phase xprompts, the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]published core version window — and produce end-to-end acceptance [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]evidence against the live store.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
